answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fake identities. Each identity costs 40 credits to join a public crystal ledger. Each epoch a comet sweep re-checks them; fees climb per source: k-th 40+12(k-1), 1,000th 12,028. Forging 1,000 costs 6,034,000 against a 40,000 pool. Caught underpaying, a ripple runs to every identity on the same source, striking the cluster. Key-splitting rings share one source, so the escalator follows them. An honest agent pays 40 once.
